name: @hafley66/grapht-render-vello-chromium
description: Vello Rust/WASM WebGPU browser projection adapter for Grapht

scripts.wasm:build: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --lib && mkdir -p wasm/pkg && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/grapht_render_vello_wgpu.wasm --target web --out-dir wasm/pkg --no-typescript
scripts.lab: node ../../scripts/0_generate_renderer_fixture.mjs 1000 && pnpm run wasm:build && playwright test -c playwright.config.ts
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && cargo test && cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
